component_policy: Only complete canonical ASCII answer bodies with one terminal EOS are parsed. Missing, malformed, non-byte and noncanonical answers receive zero component credit. These supplementary counts cannot replace complete-answer/EOS gates.

curriculum.fold: count, sum, squares separately; retain all related inputs/carriers in their original family/split
curriculum.lattice: traversal value and x/y/z separately; other lattice tasks unchanged; parent traversal/address family remains intact
curriculum.training: pending separate frozen matched budget/exposure/checkpoint/gate protocol; no inference from preparation

decision: Characterize retained failures before more optimization. Prepare scalar fold and traversal targets over exactly the same numeric facts and family splits. Arithmetic remains unchanged as a control. No training or automatic curriculum/model selection in this increment.
diagnostics: exact answer plus EOS, answer-only with valid final EOS, missing EOS, non-byte or misplaced special tokens, wrong-answer partition
training-answer and prompt-byte vocabulary coverage by task
canonical complete fold count/sum/squares component correctness
canonical complete lattice traversal coordinate correctness
scope: Post-hoc descriptive diagnostics of already visible, finite, same-host exploratory outcomes; no fresh confirmatory evidence, significance, causal failure attribution or independent optimizer replay.
verification: Fresh authoritative learning summarize(publish=False), full closed bundle/checkpoint/prediction/loss regeneration and exact retained-summary comparison before diagnostics; no archived verifier-success cache.
